en.title: The Writer's Quarter
en.summary: The Writer's Quarter is discussed as AI-free writing and novel planning software. The topic appeared on Product Hunt.
en.impact: This tool may appeal to writers and users looking for creative software options that do not utilize artificial intelligence.
keyPoints: Focuses on AI-free writing and novel planning
